core.notes:
Pop-ups no longer lock when you click them: drag one at least a short way to keep it (a dashed outline shows where it came from, a lock icon shows once it will stay, and a short drag springs back)
Sculpture Grid Overlay: Grid Overlay: a new Relative button next to the rotate button switches on the Relative view, which shows each sculpture's Roll Relative, how strong its own rolls are in one unit for every mod (1 Relative is an average roll of that mod on an item level 100 sculpture). While Relative is on, the rotate button goes rolls, item levels, Relative; with it off it only swaps rolls and item levels. The button's pop-up explains it, and it remembers whether you left it on
Sculpture Grid Overlay: Grid Overlay: "Grid Strength" (the grid's total, in Relative) now sits right of the game's "Multipliers" heading and is taken from the Multipliers panel itself; hover it to see each mod's Relative and whether the overlay's own sums agree. If the panel cannot be read it falls back to the overlay's own sums and says so
Sculpture Grid Overlay: Grid Overlay: hovering a tile in the Relative view shows its Roll Relative and what it adds to the Grid Strength there ("Roll 1.55 Relative · adds 31.2 Grid Strength here"). Relative needs your tile levels; until the page has shown them it says "—" instead of guessing
Sculpture Grid Overlay: Grid Overlay: the overlay switch, the rotate button and the Relative button stay on their own row; extra controls from add-ons get a second row under it, shown while Relative is on
Sculpture Grid Overlay: Grid Overlay: the pop-ups on its buttons, on Grid Strength and on the tiles now look like the rest of AWOO+ instead of the browser's plain ones
Sculpture Grid Overlay: Grid Overlay: "Overlay starts as" now offers only rolls or item levels; Relative is the Relative button, which is remembered
Sculpture Grid Overlay: Grid Overlay: remembers the last grid you looked at so other tools can use it, even after a reload
